assumptions: two independent samples from normal populations with equal variances (pooled-variance Student t test; G*Power offers no Welch variant)
d = (mu1 - mu2) / sigma; df = n1 + n2 - 2; ncp = d * sqrt(n1 * n2 / (n1 + n2)) (manual 21.5)
two-sided test: alpha/2 in each tail; the power counts both rejection tails (G*Power convention, manual 25.5)

diagnostics.allocation_rule: allocation ratio r = N2/N1: N = the smallest even N >= 4 whose power with fractional group sizes N/(1 + r), rN/(1 + r) reaches the target (G*Power 3.1.9.7), split as n1 = floor(N/(1 + r) + 1/2), n2 = N - n1; where that design misses the target or leaves a group empty, the next even N whose split reaches the target (validation/compare/t_means_two_independent/allocation-rule.md); r = 1: n1 = n2 = N/2
